facts.text: Serve the snacks when Pat Sr lays out his game day spread for the Eagles.
facts.why: Dolores makes the game day food, her crabby snacks and homemades. Pat Sr does the rituals, remotes lined up and a lucky bandana. The data cue has the same text.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Dolores puts out her crabby snacks for the Eagles game.

facts.text: Raisin bran in a takeaway bag, that's my order. Tiffany says it's not a date, so I'm skipping the crumbs.
facts.why: In the film Pat says he ordered raisin bran so nobody mistakes it for a date, and Tiffany replies that it can still be a date. The takeaway bag is not in the film.
facts.fix: Raisin bran, that's my order. Nobody mistakes it for a date. Tiffany says it still can be.

fix_note.text: Raisin bran, that's my order. Nobody mistakes it for a date. Tiffany says it still can be.

facts.text: Excelsior. Pat's word, and now Tiffany's.
facts.why: Pat says Excelsior three times in the scene found. No source shows Tiffany saying it.
facts.fix: Excelsior. Pat's word, said three times.

facts.text: Pat's mum Dolores cooking for the family on game day.
facts.why: Dolores does cook game day food, but it is crabby snacks and homemades, not Sunday gravy with rigatoni.
facts.fix: Dolores cooking her homemades for the family on game day.

vibe.verdict: Good game day food and Pat's habits, but the cafe layout does not feel like the Solitano house and two lines get the plot wrong.
